info.title: Library of Congress Universal API
info.description: Search and retrieve public Library of Congress collections, items, resources, and collection metadata through the official loc.gov JSON/YAML API.

get.description: Retrieves a Library of Congress digital collection.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: The kebab-case loc.gov collection slug, such as civil-war-maps or baseball-cards.
